en: A place that is ever shifting. It's almost as though it's some kind of debug area.
ctx: world map location description

en: This prison is built inside of an ancient fortress. It was with no small amount of luck that you escaped the grounds, and returning would likely be suicidal.
ctx: world map location description

en: An opening in the cliff face leads to a twisting tunnel. A way through the mountains, perhaps?
ctx: world map location description

en: A sheltered burrow in the face of the cliff.
ctx: world map location description

en: The entrance to this place is in poor repair, but it seems as though someone has made an attempt to tidy it up.
ctx: world map location description

en: A lot of info could be stored here. I wonder how much is too much?
ctx: world map location description

en: This tomb is deocated in lavish carvings. Judging by the imagery, the person buried here was a blacksmith of some renown.
ctx: world map location description

en: A pathway winding through seaside caves. Tidal pools, difficult footing, and a salty chill make this area uninviting.
ctx: world map location description

en: A small, disused marina. It's a decent enough shelter, but it clearly hasn't been used in a long, long time.
ctx: world map location description

en: This grand shipyard must once have produced many fine ships. There are a few husks remaining, some of them still floating.
ctx: world map location description

en: A lightly wooded area along the northern edge of the Knightwood forest.
ctx: world map location description

en: A strange golden metal lines the walls of this bizarre tomb. Who knows what you mght encounter inside? Best be well-prepared.
ctx: world map location description

en: This heavily fortified gate is engraved with many images of diving birds of prey. It looks important.
ctx: world map location description

en: An ancient crypt choked with the scent of stale spices.
ctx: world map location description

en: This crumbling gate is engraved with images depicting a king wielding godlike powers, and his subjects cowering before him.
ctx: world map location description

en: What's left of a modest labour camp set at the foot of the Brad'uk.
ctx: world map location description

en: An old, sprawling dungeon with some signs of recent activity. Maybe something useful could be found inside.
ctx: world map location description

en: This eerie tomb is decorated in dark, disturbing imagery. Who knows what horrors could be waiting inside?
ctx: world map location description

en: A gate marked with morbid imagery. The air is stale and cold.
ctx: world map location description

en: This white tower stands on a hidden plateau, nestled within the mountains.
ctx: world map location description

en: This gate is solid, but it feels stately and dignified.
ctx: world map location description

en: The floor and walls have a pulse, and the barely breathable air churns with wet fumes. It's clearly alive, but does it have a mind?
ctx: world map location description

en: Despite being made of rusted metal panelling, this gate is still very sturdy.
ctx: world map location description

en: These old ruins appear to have been a chapel, once upon a time.
ctx: world map location description

en: There is a cloud of steam hanging heavy around this place, and the wet air carries an eerie odour.
ctx: world map location description

en: There is a cloud of fragrant steam hanging heavy around this place, and the wet air carries an eerie odour.
ctx: world map location description

en: The ruins of many ships have been crushed together in this hidden cove.
ctx: world map location description

en: There is a great deal of moisture covering the walls and floor of this gate, but it appears to be very solid regardless.
ctx: world map location description

en: A partially-restored town amid the twisted trees of the overgrown Knightwood.
ctx: world map location description

en: This small roadside inn is still in excellent condition. It appears that someone has been tending it.
ctx: world map location description

en: Though it is old and rusting, this ironclad bunker is holding up well.
ctx: world map location description

en: The ruins of what must have once been a grand home. There is not much left.
ctx: world map location description

en: The ground surrounding this cabin is warm and black, and there is a heavy smoke hanging in the air.
ctx: world map location description

en: The dust swirls thick about this place, but you can see occasional lights drifting through grimy windows. It is not as empty as it seems.
ctx: world map location description

en: A small camp is set up here. A logging camp, judging by the large number of nearby felled trees.
ctx: world map location description
world map location description

en: This opulent, well-maintained manor is easy to spot amid the tangled trees and ruined streets.
ctx: world map location description

en: An ominous door leads to stairs that carry you to a dank dungeon beneath Laughlan Manor.
ctx: world map location description

en: Though the signage bears welcoming messages, the architecture of this place is sinister and foreboding. Something is not right here.
ctx: world map location description

en: This place has clearly seen better days. It looks like it could collapse further at any moment.
ctx: world map location description

en: This gate is certainly shut, but it almost seems as though opening it could bring the whole place down. Tread carefully here.
ctx: world map location description

en: Hot, dry air spills out of the entrance. This promises to be uncomfortable.
ctx: world map location description

en: It is too dark to see what's inside this place, but there is a dark, maleficent energy hanging in the air.
ctx: world map location description

en: Stairs lead up to these stately loft apartments that have only the slightest lingering scent of blood.
ctx: world map location description

en: A dry heat emanates from this sealed gate, and it is difficult to force your lungs to take in the air. Whatever is creating the heat must be behind the gate.
ctx: world map location description

en: A sickeningly sweet odour drifts from the entrance of this hidden place.
ctx: world map location description

en: A moist, nauseating miasma lingers around the mouth of this ancient gate.
ctx: world map location description

en: Once long ago, this must have been a well-used trail through the wood. Now it is barely wide enough to walk, choked with trees so thick, you can barely see your next step.
ctx: world map location description

en: The door to this place opens to reveal a marble temple slick with brine. Tread carefully.
ctx: world map location description

en: This marble gate is covered in barnacles, and the floor is littered with the shells of small ocean life.
ctx: world map location description

en: This tomb is decorated in lavish carvings. Judging by the imagery, the person buried here was a blacksmith of some renown.
ctx: world map location description

en: The ruins of what must have once been a stately abbey. Now the building is cracked and sunken, and the surrounding vegetation appears to be devouring what little is left.
ctx: world map location description

en: An old crumbling fort along the road. It surely has seen better days, but it makes a tempting shelter. No doubt others have also had this thought.
ctx: world map location description

en: This garden must have once been quite grand. Now, it is overgrown and dilapidated, like the rest of the island.
ctx: world map location description

en: This looks like it may once have been a bookseller's shop. It appears to have seen recent use.
ctx: world map location description

en: A small hamlet along the road running through the foothills. It was likely once a stopover point for travellers.
ctx: world map location description

en: An acrid odour drifts through the thin trees, and in the distance, you can see a pale haze settling.

en: This place appears to have been an inn or something similar. The pungent smell of mineral water clings to everything.

en: A tiny clearing in the forest, barely big enough to start a fire and dry your clothes, but a decent enough place to rest.

en: This once-imposing gate is now heavily scabbed with rust and decay.

en: A narrow path slices its way up the side of this cliff face. It's likely to be very dangerous.

en: The foul air in this humid tunnel is difficult to breathe. It is difficult to imagine anything living here.

en: A long-abandoned church. Part of it has collapsed, now overtaken with some kind of fleshy slime, as though the building is being slowly devoured.

en: What was once a major river crossing has been reduced to a few skeletal bridge struts. Perhaps there's still a workable path across.

en: The darkness is stifling, and the layout is obviously designed to confuse and disorient you. Whatever is confined within must be very well-worth confining.

en: This is an impressive fortress, but it is haunted by a peculiar odour.
ctx: world map location description

en: This gate seems strange. It is obviously sturdy, and well-decorated, but it seems as though it was hastily-built, with the pleasantries added as an afterthought.

en: Many structures you have seen are in grievous disrepair, but this one seems worse than most. It seems like it could topple in on itself at any moment.

en: A vast lake of churning fluid stretches out into the darkness. There is a path, but it is not likely to be a fun trip.

en: This place appears to be some kind of transport hub, but there is a peculiar odour clinging to the air, and a heavy, warm moisture that makes your skin crawl.

en: This appears to be some kind of transport terminal. The buildings are still in excellent shape, but there is a slime-infested tunnel diving into the earth nearby.

en: This cave is too cluttered to be abandoned, but too orderly to be occupied by mere animals. Something intelligent lives here.

en: This strong gate has clearly been manufactured, but there are no signs of toolwork on any of the stones.

en: From the ground, you can see a white building shining at the top of this daunting cliff face.

en: Calling this town run-down would be an understatement, but the inhabitants are at least attempting to make it livable. You might be able to get some supplies here.

en: Water still flows through this section of aqueduct, a testament to its solid workmanship. Of course, who knows what else might be taking advantage of it?

en: There is a small shack and a workshop here. Someone clearly lives here.

en: A bridge still crosses over a narrow stretch of river here, as well as the ruins of some sort of small rest stop.

en: This ancient forest temple is collapsed and overgrown, but there is still something serene and beautiful about it.

en: There is a large farmhouse here that seems to have weathered the years better than most. It might make a decent shelter.

en: This was once used by nobles to take scenic tours up the mountainside. Someone has taken great pains to keep it maintained.

en: In every way, this place is the very picture of a wizard's tower. Though it appears to be abandoned, you're likely to find all manner of strangeness inside.

en: This abbey may be run-down, but what is left of it is obviously still well-tended.

en: There is a small village here scrapped together from old wood. Whoever built this was not very forward-thinking.

en: This stretch of roadway is soggy and sinking.

en: This appears to once have been a rural family home, but it has been standing disused for many years.
